about_short_description.short_description: JITX provides electronic design as a service.

product.name: JITX Electronic Systems Design Platform
product.description: A software platform that automates the design of electronic circuit boards from code, including schematic generation, PCB layout, and verification checks.

identifier.value: Design Automation with Signal Integrity Optimization

product.name: Design Automation with Signal Integrity Optimization
product.description: A feature that automates signal integrity constraints and optimizes pin assignments during PCB design to improve reliability and reduce design errors.

product.name: Modular and Reusable Circuit Design
product.description: A capability that enables encapsulation of subcircuits into reusable modules for use across multiple projects, facilitating design reuse and updates.

product.name: Automated Design Verification and Checks
product.description: Automated expert-level design checks that verify circuit parameters and compliance with specifications during the design process.

product.name: Supply Chain Part Substitution Management
product.description: A tool to manage and verify replacement of out-of-stock components in designs, ensuring continued functionality and compliance.
